perAiBr.statement: Data Section No. 3 of a Financial Transaction Request contains none, one, or more of the following data segments: Fleet (101), Product Code (102), EBT (103), Purchase Card (104), Variable Information (111), per the Data Section No. 3 table.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Data Section No. 3 may include segments 101, 102, 103, 104, and/or 111 as applicable

perAiBr.statement: Fleet Data Segment (101) is sent only on transactions requiring fleet data.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Include segment 101

perAiBr.statement: Segments 101–145 in Financial Transaction Request occupy Field Nos. 4–9 with specified maximum lengths (101:308, 102:381, 103:3334, 104:86, 111:999, 123:186, 135:110, 143:399, 145:999).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Adhere to stated max lengths in fields 4–9

perAiBr.statement: EMV Financial Transaction Request Data Section No. 3 contains one or more of: Fleet (101), Product Code (102), Purchase Card (104), Variable Information (111), EMV Request (130).
perAiBr.constraint_text: At least one of these segments included

perAiBr.statement: Segment 101 (Fleet Data Segment) is sent only on transactions requiring fleet data.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Include Segment 101

perAiBr.statement: The Fleet Data Segment (Data Segment No. 101) is included in all fleet card transaction requests.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Fleet Data Segment (101) must be included in the request

perAiBr.statement: Merchants should not send the Fleet Data Segment (101) and the Enhanced Fleet Data Segment (145) together in the same message.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Enhanced Fleet Data Segment (145) must not also be present (and vice versa)

perAiBr.statement: The Fleet Data Segment has a maximum length of 61 characters, alphanumeric (0-9, a-z, A-Z).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Max length 61; character set 0-9/a-z/A-Z

perAiBr.statement: All fields in the Fleet Data Segment are separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the Field Separator must still be sent.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Field Separator must still be transmitted in its position

perAiBr.statement: Segment Type field in the Fleet Data Segment has fixed value 101.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Segment Type = 101

perAiBr.statement: Segment Length field identifies the data segment's length, including the Segment Type field's length and Field Separators.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Segment Length value must include Segment Type length and Field Separators

perAiBr.statement: The Fleet Data Segment originates at the device and can appear in any of the fields in Data Section No. 3.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Source = Device; placement = any field of Data Section No. 3

perAiBr.statement: Fleet Tag 1–5 fields are sent only in the Auth Completion (0220) message, and only when Host Prompts are supported.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Fleet Tag 1–5 may be sent (Tag=3 bytes fixed, Data up to 31 bytes)

perAiBr.statement: Each Fleet Tag consists of a 3-byte fixed-length Tag code followed by up to 31 bytes of Data.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Tag = 3 bytes fixed length; Data = up to 31 bytes

perAiBr.statement: The 3-byte Fleet Tag code must be one of: DLS (Driver License State/Province Abbrev, an3), DLN (Driver License name, an22), PON (Work Order/P.O. Number, an31), INV (Invoice Number, an31), TRP (Trip Number, an15), UNT (Unit Number, an31).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Tag code ∈ {DLS, DLN, PON, INV, TRP, UNT}

perAiBr.statement: Merchants must not send Fleet segment (Data Segment No. 101) and Enhanced Fleet segment (Data Segment No. 145) together.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Fleet Segment (101) must not also be present (and vice versa)

perAiBr.statement: If required by the issuer, the Driver/Identification Number must be an unencrypted value and is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Must be unencrypted and carried in Fleet Data Segment 101

perAiBr.statement: If required by the issuer, Fleet Employee Number is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Element must appear in Fleet Data Segment (101)

perAiBr.statement: If required by the issuer, the Job Number element is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Job Number appears in Fleet Data Segment (101)

perAiBr.statement: For Financial Transaction Requests, zero, one, or more of Data Segments 101 (Fleet), 102 (Product Code), 103 (EBT), 104 (Purchase Card), and 111 (Variable Information) may also follow.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Segments 101, 102, 103, 104, 111 are optional (none, one, or more)

perAiBr.statement: If required by the issuer, the Odometer element is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Odometer placed in Fleet Data Segment (101)

perAiBr.statement: Fleet Data Segment (No. 101) Segment Length valid values are 001–61.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Length 001–61

perAiBr.statement: Vehicle Number is found in the Fleet Data Segment (101) if required by the issuer.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Present in Fleet Data Segment (101)

perAiBr.statement: If required by the issuer, License # (Element 158) is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment 101) and identifies the License # of the fleet card user.
perAiBr.constraint_text: License # present in Fleet Data Segment

perAiBr.statement: If required by issuer, Job ID is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Job ID present in Fleet Data Segment

perAiBr.statement: If required by issuer, Department # is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Department # present in Fleet Data Segment

perAiBr.statement: If required by issuer, Customer Data is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Customer Data present in Fleet Data Segment

perAiBr.statement: If required by issuer, the User ID element is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: User ID present in Fleet Data Segment (101)

perAiBr.statement: If required by issuer, the Vehicle ID# element is found in the Fleet Data Segment (Segment No. 101).
perAiBr.constraint_text: Vehicle ID# present in Fleet Data Segment (101)

perAiBr.statement: Value 28 indicates 'Unattended off premise customer-operated internet (nonsecure)' - a non-secure transaction in which the cardholder's payment card data was transmitted with no security method.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Denotes unattended off-premise customer-operated nonsecure internet transaction

perAiBr.statement: A prior value (context continuation) indicates a transaction protected with a form of internet security such as SSL, but where authentication was not performed.
perAiBr.constraint_text: Indicates SSL-protected but non-authenticated internet transaction
